features.name: Replies that remember the week
say: what was that train you found me on Tuesday?
remind me what we said about the boiler
features.does: Every chat is kept as a short note for 30 days (your words and the first line of the answer); when you ask something, up to four matching notes from the last week go into the reply, so Ghosty can say 'like you said on Tuesday'.
features.note: Matching is by your words; matching by meaning on the brain is not built yet.

features.name: RECALL button under a reply
features.where: HOME → the chat log, under a reply that says 'like you said on …'
say: (appears by itself)
features.does: One tap opens the chat it means, or shows the quote if that chat has left the log.

features.name: What did I ask you about…?
features.where: HOME chat, or ME → MEMORY → TIMELINE search box
say: what did I ask you about trains?
when did I mention the boiler?
did I tell you about my knee?
features.does: Answered on the phone in well under a second with no internet: each time you asked, its day and where (app or Telegram), best three first; a tap opens that chat.
features.note: If the phone's index has never been built and you are online, the brain answers instead.

features.name: Find in my things
features.where: HOME chat, or ME → MEMORY → TIMELINE search box
say: find garden in my things
search my notes for invoice
features.does: Searches your documents, workspace pages, decks, sheets and chats on the phone; a tap opens the thing at the matching paragraph.
features.note: Scanned pages count only once saved as a document; the jump bar does not search here yet.

features.name: Recall on Telegram
say: what did I ask you about trains?
features.does: The brain lists the matching chats from the last 30 days with their day and where.

features.name: Forget a chat, with UNDO
features.where: On a RECALL card row → FORGET; ME → MEMORY → RECENTLY FORGOTTEN
say: (tap FORGET)
features.does: That chat leaves recall on the phone and on the brain at once; UNDO brings it back for a day.

features.name: Clear conversation clears recall
say: clear the conversation
features.does: Clearing the conversation also clears the 30 days of notes and the phone's recall of those chats.

features.name: Chase a reply for me
features.where: HOME chat; listed in PLAN → AGENDA → WATCHERS (under Spending on the phone)
say: remind me to chase this if Sam doesn't reply by Thursday
chase it if they haven't answered by Friday
features.does: Says once what it will do; at 9 am that day it looks in the mail you already linked for a reply from that person and tells you either 'Sam replied on Wednesday; nothing to chase' or reminds you with DRAFT A CHASE (sending still needs your tap).
features.note: It finds the mail by who sent it, not by the exact thread; with no mail linked it is a plain dated reminder and says so.

features.name: What are you chasing?
say: what are you chasing?
any chases?
features.does: Lists the chases still waiting, each with its morning.

features.name: Recall index size and CLEAR
say: (look)
features.does: Shows how big the phone's recall index is (kept only on the phone) with CLEAR; it rebuilds while the phone sits idle, on charge or above half battery.

features.name: Meaning search on the phone
features.where: SETTINGS → OFFLINE BRAIN → Search by meaning (download on your tap, on Wi-Fi, size said)
say: (download once)
features.does: With the meaning model downloaded, recall and find also match by meaning, not just words, still on the phone.
features.note: Meaning is only used once the model is already loaded; it never waits for it to load.

features.name: Memory timeline, Me, Diary, Patterns, Lessons
say: what do you remember about me?
remember I take my coffee black
forget that
features.does: Everything Ghosty keeps about you, each with where it came from: edit, LOCK, FORGET with UNDO, FADING (keep or let go), the nightly diary, and patterns from your own chats.
features.note: Built before this round; the final round added the recall search above to it.

upward.idea: Recall by meaning on the brain too
upward.why: Telegram and a cold phone would find 'the trip north' when you said 'Leeds trains'
upward.builds_on: the 30-day notes and the free models the brain already uses

upward.idea: A chase that follows the exact email thread
upward.why: no false 'replied' when the same person writes about something else
upward.builds_on: the chase watcher and the Brief's mail reading

upward.idea: CHASE key on each mail in the Brief
upward.why: one tap instead of saying the sentence
upward.builds_on: the Brief's email line and the chase watcher

upward.idea: Chase follow-ups: 'and again Monday if still nothing'
upward.why: holds a chase for a week without you minding it

upward.idea: A Week in review card from your own chats
upward.why: Sunday evening: what you asked about most, what you finished, what is still open

upward.idea: Open threads: questions you asked that never got a real answer
upward.why: nothing you meant to come back to is lost
upward.builds_on: the notes (your question plus the answer's first line)

upward.idea: Recall shows the whole exchange in a card
upward.why: see what was said without leaving where you are
upward.builds_on: the RECALL card and the chat log

upward.idea: Date words in the question: 'what did I ask last March about the car?'
upward.why: narrows recall the way you think about time
upward.builds_on: the day words recall already uses

upward.idea: Find opens spreadsheets at the cell and decks at the slide
upward.why: lands exactly where the match is, like documents already do

upward.idea: Jump bar runs Find from the third word
upward.why: search everything of yours from anywhere
upward.builds_on: the jump bar and the phone's index

upward.idea: Pin a chat so it never fades from recall
upward.why: the important ones stay past 30 days

upward.idea: Recall answers spoken back in one sentence
upward.builds_on: the recall card and the phone's voice

sideways.idea: Find in scanned pages and the Lens's read text as soon as they are read
sideways.why: 'where's that letter about the parking fine?' finds the photo you read
sideways.builds_on: the scanner and the Lens's reading, and the phone index

sideways.idea: Find in your saved links and the library
sideways.why: one search across everything you keep
sideways.builds_on: the library's own search and the phone index

sideways.idea: Promise keeper: 'you said you'd send Jo the photos'
sideways.why: reminds you of things YOU said you would do
sideways.builds_on: your own words in the notes and reminders

sideways.idea: Chase anything, not just mail: 'if the parcel hasn't come by Friday'
sideways.why: one way to hold any wait
sideways.builds_on: the chase watcher and the parcel and page watchers

sideways.idea: Remember where I put it: 'the spare key is in the blue tin'
sideways.why: ask later and it says where

sideways.idea: Export your memory as one tidy document
sideways.builds_on: the Docs editor and the memory timeline

sideways.idea: Find by date: 'what was I doing on the 3rd?'
sideways.why: your own day, rebuilt from chats, diary and reminders
sideways.builds_on: the diary, the notes and the agenda

sideways.idea: Decision log: 'why did I pick the canal flat?'
sideways.why: recalls the reasons you gave at the time
no 'like you said' lines when you want a clean answer

cross.idea: Recall inside the editors: 'what did I say about the hedge?' while writing the letter
cross.why: brings your earlier words into the document you are writing

cross.idea: The Brief's mail line offers CHASE and shows chases due today

many wordings of 'what did I ask' heard and answered aloud
